Its whole reason to exist is one invariant stated in its own header: 'missing state may bootstrap once, while existing invalid state is unavailable and is never repaired or replaced.' If that regresses to repair-by-regenerate, a truncated or corrupted key file is silently replaced — every previously signed tool manifest fails verification and every paired iOS device silently de-pairs, and the app presents it as a clean first-run bootstrap.
